name: Long-beaked echidna
desc: An egg-laying mammal of hill and montane forest that feeds mainly on earthworms, unlike the ant-eating short-beaked echidna.
about: The western long-beaked echidna, also called Bruijin's long-beaked echidna, is one of the four extant echidnas and one of three species of Zaglossus that occurs in New Guinea.
